allocation: synthetic T0 method construction; no GUI or human allocation
container: not used; Docker Desktop daemon/WSL backend did not answer diagnostic window; no image ID
source_boundary: WCAG 2.2 criteria and WAI-ARIA APG inform web interaction invariants only. WCAG Understanding documents are informative guidance; no native-desktop conformance claim is made.
H: A private model-only cue or genuinely passive shared cue can preserve the fixture's declared human/AT interaction signals; an intrusive shared cue is detected as a non-interference failure; missing AT observability yields HOLD.
T: Four finite conditions (no cue, model-only private composite, shared passive, shared intrusive negative control) plus AT-backend-unavailable HOLD. Exhaustively inject all 2^9 combinations of nine invariant violations and audit 512 resulting profiles.
D: METHOD_PASS_SCOPED only if the three declared non-intrusive conditions pass, the intrusive control fails, AT-unavailable returns HOLD, all 511 nonempty invariant-fault profiles fail, clean profile passes, and independent audit agrees.
C: The fixture stipulates screen/focus/AT observations and cue effects; it contains no real accessibility API, screen reader, keyboard device, GUI app, user or actual task. Signals are deterministic by construction.
U: No inference about lived accessibility, WCAG conformance, native overlays, browser/OS interoperability, cognitive load, contrast, or production non-interference. Only nine synthetic binary invariants and one synthetic task-effect surrogate are covered.
decision: Run frozen candidate once, independent raw-only audit once, and local tests. No tuning/retry after candidate; any deviation is retained as FAIL/HOLD. No T1 or product promotion follows automatically.
